triggerReason: v1.1 could generate production evidence, but release authority was not yet bound to tenant identity, live prompt regression, exact external provenance, deployment telemetry, or recurring recovery evidence.
action: Added workspace/principal authorization, least-privilege service accounts, exact artifact receipts after GitHub Sigstore verification, a 12-case live model regression gate, HTTP deployment telemetry and progressive traffic, automatic platform rollback, scheduled recovery/rollback drills, retained attestations, and human-facing governance views.
outcome: NEXUS-7 now separates proposing a change, proving its quality, authorizing its release, observing its canary, and recovering from failure into independently verifiable control points.
evidence: All 12 deterministic model cases pass with zero fallback, error, or forbidden actions
A fake OpenAI Responses server passes the full strict-schema regression contract
Code and deployment proposals cannot progress without an exact, signed, unexpired external receipt
Service-account admins cannot approve while human admins can
Healthy deployment telemetry progresses traffic from 5% to 100%
Injected deployment failure triggers critical alerts and returns traffic to 0%
Recovery drill proves exact table restore, deterministic report equality, lease clearing, sequence recovery, RPO, and RTO
Daily model and weekly operations workflows retain and attest their reports
